statement: The library shall compute wheel blade azimuth as `datum + sign(rpm) theta_i` in both sections and `_qs_positions.csv`, giving `datum - theta_i` for `rpm_sign = -1`.
rationale: Design constraint: placed_blade_azimuth_deg and clocked_blade_azimuth_deg in pyflightstream.post.axes supply the blade-placement and clocking rules.

statement: The library shall expose `pyfs-workspace field mirror|move|subtract|time-mean` for custom free-stream files under `inputs/freestreams/` in global-frame metres and metres per second without conversion.
The library shall mirror fields through the x, y or z zero plane selected by `--plane`.
The library shall translate fields so the source point lands on the target point.
The library shall subtract fields pointwise on one grid as `total - (other - reference)`, requiring `--reference VX VY VZ`.
The library shall compute field time means from equally spaced per-step fields of an unsteady run.

The library shall accept `[qsteady_correction]` route `none` (default), `table` (fitted calibration, route 4) or `sector_offset` (axial unsteady-sector 0P offset, route 2), with calibration `file` and `diagnostic`.
rationale: Quasi-steady corrections are off by default and NOT VALIDATED.

statement: The library shall create the `inputs/calibrations/<id>.toml` input kind during workspace initialization.
rationale: Quasi-steady corrections are off by default and NOT VALIDATED.

statement: The library shall compute `MU_ROTOR` and `LAMBDA_C` from in-disc and through-disc free-stream velocity divided by tip speed.
The library shall compute momentum-theory `LAMBDA_I` by Newton solution of the Glauert relation to 1e-10 and wake skew `CHI_DEG` from mean clocking thrust.
The library shall place rotor-state quantities after validity columns in `_qs_avg.csv` and under `rotor_state` in `<point>_qsteady_validity.json`.
rationale: Design constraint: _qs_avg.csv is the established public rotor-state table location.

statement: The library shall report nonconverged inflow as `NA` with a `post.log` warning.

The library shall append `CN_<alias>`, `CS_<alias>`, `CMN_<alias>` and `CMS_<alias>` after `MTIP_<alias>` and `MHEL_<alias>`, normalizing normal and side forces by `rho n^2 D^4` and hub moments by `rho n^2 D^5`.
The library shall use right-handed rotor axes with T along the rotor axis, N along reference +z projected normal to T, and `S = N x T`.
The library shall write `NA` in all four crossflow coefficient columns for a rotor aligned with up, with one post-log diagnostic.
The library shall compute wheel rows in `polars/P<sim>-<ALIAS>_rotor.csv` from mean force and moment across all k clockings' loads exports.
The library shall derive `CT`, `CQ`, `CP`, `ETA`, `ETAW`, `CN`, `CS`, `CMN`, `CMS` from mean clocking loads rather than averaging per-clocking efficiency.
The library shall record wheel table `source` as `mean of k clockings` and `clockings` as k in `products.json`.
The library shall omit wheel points with missing clocking exports, naming the point in `skipped`.
The library shall preserve sector rows.

The library shall compute observer pressure using the compact-source loading term of Farassat Formulation 1A in a stationary medium, retaining near-field terms without thickness noise, so unloaded moving blades remain silent.
rationale: Model references: Farassat, NASA/TM-2007-214853 (2007) [REF-10]; Brentner and Farassat, Progress in Aerospace Sciences 39 (2003) [REF-11].

statement: The library shall expose the compact-source model without invoking the model from post.
rationale: Model references: Farassat, NASA/TM-2007-214853 (2007) [REF-10]; Brentner and Farassat, Progress in Aerospace Sciences 39 (2003) [REF-11].

statement: The library shall least-squares fit axial, tangential and radial blade forces as Fourier series in azimuth from fixed-frame blade force and hub moment.
The library shall refuse more than `(distinct - 1) // 2` harmonics with `ProductError`.
The library shall use mean moments divided by mean forces for unspecified centroid radii, refusing zero mean force or nonpositive radius.
The library shall refuse a source speed bound not below `c0` with `ProductError`.
The library shall restrict post-processing and collection to named simulations under `--sims`, exposed as `sims` in `write_campaign_products`, `collect_once` and `collect_and_post`.
The library shall replace only selected simulations' entries and skips in a partial post's `products.json`.
The library shall rebuild section measurements from all recorded matrix simulations only when every required folder is readable, otherwise retaining the previous measurement.
The library shall identify every retained partial-post product and reason in `products.json` under `partial.not_rebuilt` and in `post.log`.
The library shall collect only selected simulations' `SUBMITTED` records, leaving other records unchanged and excluded from outstanding counts.
The library shall limit collection-triggered post to the same selected simulations.
The library shall accept simulation selectors as words, comma-separated values or bracketed lists through --sims ID [ID ...].
rationale: approved owner-list.md entries 33, 34 and 50 (0.42.0/srs), unified simulation-selector grammar. PFS-2124.003: Merged implementation traceability at the application base. statement: The library shall refuse selected simulations without records before work, requiring matrix records for post and naming the simulation.

The library shall produce radial thrust profiles through `pyfs-workspace profile` from written POL sections or a generic shape, scaled to a target, as `inputs/profiles/<stem>.csv` with `<stem>.provenance.json` for `PROFILE: <stem>`.
The library shall refuse both or neither of `--thrust` and `--ct`, and CT requests lacking `--rho` or `--rpm`.
The library shall recompute written profile-row integrals by the trapezoid rule into `integral.blades_times_integral_n` and `integral.relative_miss`.
The library shall refuse serialized profiles missing target thrust by more than one part in 10^9.
The library shall serialize actuator profiles as radius and per-blade force per length in the run-reader format without header, count line or final newline.
The library shall preview profile generation by default, writing only with `--apply` and replacing existing files or records only with `--overwrite`.
The library shall refuse profile stems already held by another folder file and options belonging to another shape.
The library shall report profile refusals on stderr with exit 2 and no writes.
The library shall document that native ELLIPTICAL discs require no profile file in command help and the profile page.
The library shall note a reference's RELAXED disc while retaining FR-646 planning warnings for RELAXED discs with profiles.
The library shall append `MESH_FACES` to superfiles and unsteady polars using only recorded geometry inventory counts, with `NA` when absent and no post-time face counting.

The library shall populate `MESH_FACES` in superfiles and `polars/P<sim>_<name>_uns_avg.csv` from the staged geometry's inventory count, preferring inventory from recorded mesh bytes and checking library inventory before the staged copy.
The library shall warn with run, inventory and both digests when inventory `mesh_sha256` differs from the recorded mesh digest, retaining the count without refusal.
The library shall write `NA` for `MESH_FACES` without a run record or inventory count.
The library shall append `MESH_FACES` after every 0.33.1 column in both products, preserving all other names, positions and cells regardless of campaign columns.
The library shall list `MESH_FACES` in each file's column list in `reports/<matrix>/superfile-<tag>.json`.
rationale: The inherited polar-column test does not check the superfile measurement report; inspect that report column inventory.

statement: The library shall read face counts from inventories without reading a mesh to count its faces during post.
The library shall write no `archive/` folder for post by default.
The library shall write the post archive folder with 0.34.0 behavior when `--archive` is supplied.

The library shall write `probes/<point>_probes.csv` from a normal entry's probe-points export, using the steady-table spine and last-step `STEP` from recorded `stopped_at`, or planned `time_iterations` when absent.

The library shall generate steady-equivalent field products, including `<stem>.inflow.dat`, from FR-887 tables for normal probes with `reusable_inflow = true` or `field_formats` on unsteady or unsteady-rotor rows.
The library shall preserve 0.36.0 behavior for unsteady probe entries with `reusable_inflow`.
The library shall write settings codebook products by default unless pproc disables `settings_codebook`.
The library shall register both settings codebook files in `products.json` with kind `settings_codebook`.
The library shall replace rebuilt codebook products under the same policy as other products.
The library shall preserve byte-identical 0.36.0 products without new files when `settings_codebook` is false.
rationale: Parity evidence is maintained in scripts/check_parity.py and the products snapshot, with changed expectations recorded in the same commit.

statement: The library shall restrict default product changes relative to 0.36.0 to the two codebook files and corresponding `products.json` entries.
rationale: Parity evidence is maintained in scripts/check_parity.py and the products snapshot, with changed expectations recorded in the same commit.

statement: The library shall accept `[products] installed_frame` as a list containing only `probes` and `inflow`, defaulting to empty.
The library shall write selected probe mirrors beside source tables as `probes/<point>_probes_installed.csv`, reflected through `y = 0`.
The library shall write selected inflow mirrors beside source profiles as `<stem>.inflow_installed.dat`, reflected through `y = 0`.
The library shall copy unclassified mirror columns unchanged, naming each once in `post.log`.
The library shall register every installed-frame copy in `products.json` with the source table in `source`, writing no copies when the selection is empty or absent.
The library shall parse 26.125 Simcenter export titles, footer, identity lines and loads header while preserving recorded 26.124 export reading.
The library's farfield core shall accept NumPy arrays, floats and defined frozen containers, returning NumPy arrays, floats and frozen dataclasses.
rationale: Design constraint: the numerical core excludes I/O and higher-layer imports to remain independent of execution and workspace state.

statement: The library's farfield core shall import no results reader or post, cases, workspace, run or script module.
rationale: Design constraint: the numerical core excludes I/O and higher-layer imports to remain independent of execution and workspace state.

statement: The library shall identify far-field analyses as `trefftz` (sections, wake, plane) or `ledgers` (balances), using the analysis word in product filenames.
The library shall name each skipped point and reason in `products.json` under `skipped` and as a `post.log` warning.
The library shall skip section Trefftz families cut in other planes or frames whose axes differ from the reference axes.
The library shall extend outer strip edges half a station spacing beyond end stations, so n uniform stations tile the solver's n-strip extent with the tip filament at the tip.
rationale: Design constraint: every family uses the core's shared extended strip-edge rule.

statement: The library shall place each family trace at station quarter-chord heights `Z_QC`, using a straight wake without roll-up, yielding a planar trace for flat wings.
The library shall mirror one-sided family stations across reference XZ before integration for `SYMMETRY = MIRROR`, placing the innermost strip's inner edge on the symmetry plane.
The library shall avoid mirroring stations already covering both sides.
The library shall skip a half-model family whose stations straddle the symmetry plane.
The library shall compute `E_T = CL_T^2 / (pi AR CDI_T)` with `AR = BREF^2 / SREF`.
The library shall report meshed-half coefficients for half models with false `SYMMETRY_LOADS`, matching polar normalization.
The library shall report `CDI_T_ISOLATED` from each family's own sheet only, with `NA` for TOTAL.
rationale: Total drag minus the sum of isolated family drags is interference drag.

statement: The library shall report station, strip width, `Gamma`, lifting-line downwash, induced angle, induced drag per unit span and local section-chord coefficient in each point-family spanwise product.
The library shall skip section Trefftz variant A at nonzero sideslip while retaining variants B and C.
The library shall warn once in both plan and post with family, station count and the definitions page's measured strip bias for that count.
The library shall recompute variant A from recorded exports when `[farfield]` is added after a run.
The library shall skip families absent from recorded sectional loads, naming the missing distribution and the remedy of planning a new run.
The library shall warn when section Trefftz lift differs from solver lift by more than five percent.
The library shall write section Trefftz diagnostic rows despite a lift-mismatch warning.
The library shall assign `CELL_DATA Normalized_Vorticity` strength to every segment of each wake line while accepting redundant native `POINT_DATA` X, Y, Z coordinate scalars and empty polygons.
The library shall refuse wake exports with nonempty polygons, inconsistent counts or strengths varying along a line.
The library shall omit zero-strength collapsed lines with a warning that omitted shed circulation can bias the result.
The library shall reconstruct consistently oriented bound circulation by cumulative differences of exported signed shed-circulation strip-edge strengths.
The library shall cut each wake line at the first plane crossing by linear interpolation on the straddling segment.
The library shall write variant B as `NA` when lines end before the plane, warning with the short-line count and recorded wake length.
The library shall order wake-sheet crossings by starting-node position along the trailing edge, preserving rolled-up topology rather than sorting crossing positions.
The library shall write variant B as `NA` with a reasoned warning when starting nodes cannot form one ordered run per sheet.
The library shall write only `FAMILY = TOTAL` for variant B without inferring family attribution absent from wake exports.
The library shall reconstruct one native mirror-export half selected by upstream nodes, omitting coincident root lines before reflecting once.
The library shall include the central strip between innermost crossings with accumulated root circulation.
The library shall return the same full-span forces from either exported half with FR-1014 and FR-1015 coefficient normalization, without mirroring both halves twice.
The library shall report `CDI_T_VORT` beside `CDI_T` from plane streamwise vorticity and the Maskell stream function.
rationale: Design constraint: the crossflow-energy balance and Trefftz C share an integrand, with V replacing sampled u for Trefftz C; disagreement between the two drag paths indicates inadequate plane extent.

statement: The library shall report the Betz-Maskell total-pressure and axial-velocity deficit term through Betz artificial velocity as `BERNOULLI_RESIDUAL` normalized by `q SREF`, without labeling the column as drag.
rationale: Bernoulli-consistent pressure and velocity give zero residual by construction; in fields with total-pressure loss the same term represents profile drag, as the definitions page explains.

statement: The library shall report axial loss, azimuthal-mean swirl loss, remaining crossflow and added total mechanical powers in W at the selected rotor Trefftz lattice station, defaulting to the last station.
The library shall compute `ETA_FF = T V / (T V + losses)`, using `NA` when V is zero.
The library shall integrate plane samples by the trapezoid rule on the uniform grid.
The library shall report `CDI_T_QERR` as the difference from a second integral using every other grid point.
The library shall report an integral as `NA` when any sample is missing or nonfinite, rather than a smaller value.
The library shall report the finite plane fraction as `COVERAGE`.
The library shall warn on plane Trefftz rows above Mach 0.3 that incompressible relations are used.
The library shall warn when the vorticity-to-near-field lift ratio indicates inadequate field coverage.

The library shall write `post/<matrix>/farfield/<group>_<analysis>.csv` per selected far-field analysis, spanwise Trefftz files and the superfile's far-field block for simulations selecting far-field post-processing.
rationale: Design constraint: one product-family step over SimContext produces the far-field products.

statement: The library shall name far-field products using the polar-table stem as `<group>` and `trefftz` or `ledgers` as `<analysis>`.
rationale: Design constraint: FARFIELD_DIR = farfield is shared with the product-folder constants.

statement: The library shall write unsteady far-field files as `<group>_<analysis>_instant.csv` for the last step and `<group>_<analysis>_average.csv` for the averaging window.
rationale: Design constraint: FARFIELD_DIR = farfield is shared with the product-folder constants.

statement: The library shall identify each unsteady far-field manifest entry's `reduction` as `instant` or `average`.
rationale: Design constraint: FARFIELD_DIR = farfield is shared with the product-folder constants.

statement: The library shall write `sections/<point>_trefftz_<family>.csv` for A and B, using family `TOTAL` for B, with the spanwise schema defined in the rationale.
rationale: Spanwise schema: POL, VARIANT, FAMILY, Y_M, Z_M, DY_M, GAMMA_M2_S, W_M_S (lifting-line downwash, positive down), ALPHA_I_DEG, DI_N_M, CDI_LOCAL (section-chord normalization; NA for B), STATUS (FR-1061).

statement: The library shall write one ledger row per point, lattice and station to `farfield/<group>_ledgers.csv` with the column schema defined in the rationale.
rationale: Ledger schema: POL, STEP, condition block, LATTICE (rotor alias or frame), STATION_X_R, MDOT_KG_S, AXIAL_FLUX_N, FX_N, FY_PLANE_N, FY_PLANE_HARMONIC_N, FZ_PLANE_N, FZ_PLANE_HARMONIC_N, FY_LATERAL_N, FZ_LATERAL_N, TORQUE_NM, MY_LOADING_NM, MY_ARM_NM, MZ_LOADING_NM, MZ_ARM_NM, E_TOTAL_W, E_SWIRL_W, E_INDUCED_W, COVERAGE, MASS_SPREAD, SYMMETRY_FLOOR, SPURIOUS_COUNTS, STATUS (FR-1061); the last four are per-point values repeated on station rows.

statement: The library shall write inlet control-volume columns (`FX_N`, `F*_PLANE*`, moments) as `NA`.
rationale: Ledger schema: POL, STEP, condition block, LATTICE (rotor alias or frame), STATION_X_R, MDOT_KG_S, AXIAL_FLUX_N, FX_N, FY_PLANE_N, FY_PLANE_HARMONIC_N, FZ_PLANE_N, FZ_PLANE_HARMONIC_N, FY_LATERAL_N, FZ_LATERAL_N, TORQUE_NM, MY_LOADING_NM, MY_ARM_NM, MZ_LOADING_NM, MZ_ARM_NM, E_TOTAL_W, E_SWIRL_W, E_INDUCED_W, COVERAGE, MASS_SPREAD, SYMMETRY_FLOOR, SPURIOUS_COUNTS, STATUS (FR-1061); the last four are per-point values repeated on station rows.

statement: The library shall use `NA`, never zero or blank, for uncomputable far-field values: missing or nonfinite samples, zero `CDI_T` for `E_T`, absent `SREF` or `BREF`, and inapplicable columns.

The library shall name each non-inapplicability `NA` with a reason in `products.json` skips under `#point=

#variant=` or `#lattice=` and in a `post.log` warning.
The library shall record exactly the source runs, analysis, variants, per-point input exports, resolution from FR-1047, A's strip rule, and B/C `x_t_m` in each far-field product entry.
The library shall skip A and B by name for steady, unsteady and quasi-steady rotor rows, retaining C and ledgers after FR-1037 quasi-steady hub-frame conversion.
The library shall enable instant and average C and ledgers for unsteady fixed-wing rows, skipping A and B by name.
The library shall restrict far-field changes to superfiles to the far-field block and to section tables to distributions added by the plan under FR-1046.
The library shall preserve byte-identical 0.39.0 snapshot products for rows without `[farfield]`.
The library shall place recorded solver termination status in each far-field row's final `STATUS` column.
The library shall append only TOTAL far-field rows as `CL_T_<VARIANT>`, `CDI_T_<VARIANT>` and `E_T_<VARIANT>` after existing superfile columns, using uppercase variant names.
The library's farfield functions shall exchange NumPy arrays and frozen containers, using `LatticeFields` for survey samples and coordinates and result dataclasses for forces and moments.
rationale: Design constraint: frozen containers and NumPy arrays replace Dataset returns at the public numerical boundary.

statement: The library shall write `streamlines/<point>_off_body.vtk` as VTK polydata with one polyline per off-body streamline and exported Mach, Cp_ref, vx, vy, vz, vtot and Cp as point data.
rationale: The off-body source is the solver export parsed by parse_off_body_streamlines.

statement: The library shall retain surface friction lines as solver files, explaining in `post.log` that VTK conversion awaits measured export grammar rather than guessing.
rationale: The off-body source is the solver export parsed by parse_off_body_streamlines.

statement: The library shall include each planned rotor diameter beside rotor speed in super content.
The library shall populate rotor and clock speed fields from recorded quasi-steady rotor speed.
The library shall refuse trimmed-polar ranges that do not bracket zero pitching moment.
rationale: PFS-2013.03.02: Trim-to-zero pitching moment is absent from the live table; the node's historical FR-20 is retired. Verification plan: test: Use synthetic bracketing and non-bracketing polars with an analytically known zero.

statement: The library shall serialize unavailable numeric cells in custom-polar and inflow tables as NA while preserving the declared column count in every row.
rationale: PFS-2110.019: No live statement fixes the missing-cell spelling and row width of these custom-polar outputs. Verification plan: test: Write unavailable and finite values through each affected public route and parse the output with csv.

statement: The library shall serialize unavailable numeric reduction values as `NA` and finite values at documented output precision.
rationale: PFS-2119.004: Define the finite and missing-value serialization of reduced tables instead of emitting raw nan. Verification plan: test: Round-trip a reduced table containing unavailable values and precision-boundary finite controls.

statement: The library shall finish requested independent products with corresponding output records despite another product's failure.
rationale: PFS-2119.030: Failure of one independent post product must not suppress other requested products or orphan their records. Verification plan: test: Inject a coefficient-product failure beside an independent valid product and inspect both output and product records.

statement: The library shall refuse existing validity-product destinations unless replacement is explicitly requested.
rationale: PFS-2124.027: Validity outputs must be confined to selected written simulations with an explicit replacement policy. Verification plan: test: Select written and unwritten simulations and test an occupied destination with and without replacement permission.

statement: The library shall report the signed nearest-bin frequency offset in bins for each acoustic harmonic product.
rationale: PFS-2124.002: New guarantee records approved 0.42.0 scope. Supplementary Code: pyflightstream.post.acoustics:write_acoustic_products. Supplementary Test: tests/tier1_offline/test_p0320_noise_post.py::test_p0420_bpf_product_states_signed_bin_offset.

statement: The library shall skip per-station harmonic fitting for a rotor whose blade distributions span multiple planes, naming the rotor and planes in the skipped result.
rationale: PFS-2119.034: New guarantee records approved 0.42.0 scope. Supplementary Code: pyflightstream.post.harmonics:station_harmonics. Supplementary Test: tests/tier1_offline/test_goal036_harmonics.py::test_p0420_harmonics_skip_rotor_with_two_section_planes.

statement: The library's emitter changes shall carry official-manual and probe-evidence clean-room provenance through a Clean-room trailer or later Clean-room-for declaration naming the commit.
The library's script builder shall refuse out-of-phase commands and references to undefined entities.
rationale: PFS-2137.073: Merged implementation anchors verified at the SRS application base. Supplementary Test: tests/tier1_offline/test_script.py::test_p0420_surface_probe_refuses_unknown_frame.

statement: The library shall record a version-mismatch warning in the manifest.
The library shall assign a status distinct from `CONVERGED` when recorded residual fails the configured convergence threshold, even with a structurally complete footer.
The library shall emit result coefficients conforming to the documented frame and sign conventions.
The library shall refuse inflow diagnostics for another rotor axis.

statement: The library shall yield first-harmonic variance share 1 for a uniform field at five degrees angle of attack.
rationale: Diagnostic quantities: variance shares for angle-of-attack harmonics 1 to 8; RMS and half peak-to-peak in degrees; plan n95; k_1P = Omega c / (2 mean V_rel); k_eff = n95 k_1P; suggested PASSAGE_POSITIONS = ceil(n_max / N + 1).

statement: The library shall warn without refusing quasi-steady points when reduced frequency exceeds 0.1 anywhere along the blade span.
The library shall report span percentage with `k > 0.1` and minimum, maximum and mean k during planning.
The library shall warn by point name when any span has `k > 0.1`.
The library shall report k as undefined without free-stream speed and rotation.
The library shall report one-blade-per-revolution custom-inflow harmonics per wheel point through `pyfs-matrix plan --inflow-fft`, using the diagnostic quantities in the rationale.
rationale: Diagnostic quantities: station n95 and k_eff = n95 k_1P; per-point minimum, maximum and mean k_eff, span percentage above 0.1, n_max and suggested PASSAGE_POSITIONS >= n_max / N + 1.

statement: The library shall warn when requested `PASSAGE_POSITIONS` is less than `n_max / N + 1`.
rationale: Diagnostic quantities: station n95 and k_eff = n95 k_1P; per-point minimum, maximum and mean k_eff, span percentage above 0.1, n_max and suggested PASSAGE_POSITIONS >= n_max / N + 1.

statement: The library shall use `k_eff` for the reduced-frequency warning with `--inflow-fft`.
rationale: Diagnostic quantities: station n95 and k_eff = n95 k_1P; per-point minimum, maximum and mean k_eff, span percentage above 0.1, n_max and suggested PASSAGE_POSITIONS >= n_max / N + 1.

statement: The library shall exclude angle-of-attack harmonics below 0.001 degree.
rationale: Diagnostic quantities: station n95 and k_eff = n95 k_1P; per-point minimum, maximum and mean k_eff, span percentage above 0.1, n_max and suggested PASSAGE_POSITIONS >= n_max / N + 1.

statement: The library shall compute `THRUST_PCT_K_GT_0_1` and `TORQUE_PCT_K_GT_0_1` using station forces projected onto recorded `axis_vector` in the distribution frame and torque from the in-plane moment about the axis.
The library shall accept XZ and XY section cuts for reduced-frequency load shares.

rationale: The cause of the measured solver failure and acceptance of any REAL argument set remain unestablished; no log line identified the cause.

rationale: Model references: Gutin (1936) [REF-12], as presented in Goldstein, Aeroacoustics (1976), chapter 3 [REF-13]; compact steady limit of Hanson, AIAA Journal 18 (1980) [REF-14].

statement: The library shall refuse unequal, short or constant signal records.

rationale: RPT-130 long-wake forward-flight licensed confirmation remains owed at 1.0.0; implemented status covers tested offline behavior.

statement: The library shall warn without refusing actuator discs combining RELAXED wake type and loading profiles.

The library shall judge CCS probe effects against a reference and unchanged control.
The library shall record requested mesh changes as unprobed for equal, absent, malformed or empty meshes.

The library shall retain unprobed restoration for missing controls, unobservable modifications and other equal-mesh cases.
The library shall establish the same defaults before a defaults probe's reference loft.
The library shall place wing-refinement zones inside the synthetic loft span with a margin at both ends.
The library shall map physical loft bounds to parametric span bounds and node count for the documented three-argument refinement grammar, rather than a Cartesian box.
The library shall save reference, modified, control and restored mesh states for fuselage and revolve relaxed-trailing-edge deletion probes.
The library shall verify deletion only through per-face state demonstrating modification, control preservation and restoration, rather than identical OBJ geometry alone.
The library shall retain unprobed status for a failed prelude with a prelude-failure diagnostic.
The library shall record `RAN_MISSING_LOG` for a point with all settled declared outputs present and an absent declared solver log.
The library shall file outputs and complete the `RAN_MISSING_LOG` record during collection.
The library shall generate every computable product for `RAN_MISSING_LOG` as for other admitted records.

The library shall determine `RAN_MISSING_LOG` at collect, grouped collect and rebuild before waiting for declared logs or reading job end files, taking precedence over `FAILED_EXECUTION` when declared outputs are present.
The library shall state in `residual_note` that the missing solver log leaves convergence verdict and solver clock unavailable.
The library shall record `wall_time_s` as null for `RAN_MISSING_LOG`, without estimating or substituting zero.
The library shall leave frozen-point readings unavailable without inferring `CONVERGED` for `RAN_MISSING_LOG`.
The library shall admit `RAN_MISSING_LOG` points to post with or without `--check-frozen`, without withholding products solely for that status.
rationale: This status-specific admission amends the unreadable-log refusal retained by the frozen-point check for other statuses (definitions invariant 12).

statement: The library shall write exactly one post-log warning per `RAN_MISSING_LOG` point naming the status and unavailable evidence, including unreadable freeze when requested.
rationale: This status-specific admission amends the unreadable-log refusal retained by the frozen-point check for other statuses (definitions invariant 12).

statement: The library shall treat `RAN_MISSING_LOG` as ended in status, show, plan and resume.
The library shall exclude `RAN_MISSING_LOG` points from resume reruns.
The library shall count `RAN_MISSING_LOG` separately from converged points.
The library shall preserve 0.36.0 behavior for `[log] export_log = false`, without assigning `RAN_MISSING_LOG` for an undeclared log.
The library shall retain `FAILED_INCOMPLETE_OUTPUT` when any other declared output is missing.
rationale: On 26.124 unsteady logs lack a completion line; ended-with-outputs does not certify solver completion.

statement: The library shall read only recorded status during post.
rationale: Design constraint: collect, grouped collect and rebuild share one status function below run; a test supplies identical files to all three paths.

statement: The library shall resolve declared logs exclusively from `submission.declared_logs` when present, including an empty list, otherwise from a readable job script, with no declared log inferred without evidence.
rationale: Design constraint: the shared workspace job-script reader supplies fallback declared-log evidence.

statement: The library shall assign `RAN_MISSING_LOG` for missing declared logs without waiting during collection.
rationale: Design constraint: the shared workspace job-script reader supplies fallback declared-log evidence.

statement: The library shall set selected point records to `CONVERGED` through `pyfs-matrix mark-converged --sims ID [ID ...] [--points NAME ...] --reason TEXT [--apply]`.
rationale: PFS-2124.004: Merged implementation traceability at the application base. Supplementary Code: pyflightstream.run._mark_converged:mark_converged. Supplementary Test: tests/tier1_offline/test_p0370_s1_mark_converged.py::test_p0370_s1_a_run_id_alias_marks_only_its_point.

statement: The library shall archive previous `runs.json` under the manifest lock before applying convergence marks.
rationale: PFS-2124.004: Merged implementation traceability at the application base. Supplementary Code: pyflightstream.run._mark_converged:mark_converged. Supplementary Test: tests/tier1_offline/test_p0370_s1_mark_converged.py::test_p0370_s1_preview_writes_nothing_and_apply_marks_with_an_archive.

statement: The library shall record prior status, time and reason under `marked` for each marked-converged record.
rationale: PFS-2124.004: Merged implementation traceability at the application base. Supplementary Code: pyflightstream.run._mark_converged:mark_converged. Supplementary Test: tests/tier1_offline/test_p0370_s1_mark_converged.py::test_p0370_s1_preview_writes_nothing_and_apply_marks_with_an_archive.

statement: The library shall require `--reason` for marking convergence.
The library shall list already-converged points without changing records.
The library shall identify marked convergence per point in `post.log`.
The library shall include `marked` in every product-index entry built from a marked point.
The library shall preserve `marked` through collect, rebuild, sync and rename without silently replacing the person's verdict with a computed verdict.
The library shall expose the same OBJ audit through `pyfs-matrix audit-mesh OBJ [--against SOURCE] [--out FILE]`, accepting deprecated `--csv` as an alias of `--out`.
The library shall return frozen `MeshAudit` from `pyflightstream.workspace.audit_mesh(mesh, *, against=None)` with each check's and gate's values, verdicts, reported figures and `passed`.
rationale: Design constraint: the named public callable returns the frozen audit result shared with the CLI.

statement: The library shall judge mesh audit G1 as passing only with at most two faces per edge, no coincident nodes within 1e-9 of mesh size, and no zero-area faces.
The library shall judge mesh audit G2 as passing only with no opposite neighbouring face orientations and positive enclosed volume for closed families.
The library shall judge mesh audit G3 by comparing open boundary loops with the source loops.
The library shall judge mesh audit G4 by checking every trailing-edge point lies on a mesh edge and the trailing-edge chain count matches the source.
The library shall judge mesh audit G5 by checking source node sharing across families is preserved.
The library shall judge mesh audit G6 by checking grid-family faces match the source at factor 1.
The library shall report the rationale's descriptive mesh-quality measures in `audit.json` without verdicts or warnings, even when the stated thresholds are exceeded.
rationale: Descriptive measures: aspect ratio; counts beyond pre-processor quality thresholds; face quality ratio interpreted from inscribed radii of a face and neighbors (manual p. 247, good below 2, no exact vendor formula); faces and trailing-edge triangles with aspect ratio above 50 (manual pp. 62, 67, 70); faces on y = 0.

statement: The library shall judge only G1, G2 and G4 without a source mesh, reporting the other checks without verdicts.
The library shall classify steady points stopped at the requested iteration limit with logged residual above convergence threshold as nonfailure `MAX_ITER_REACHED`.

The library shall assign `MAX_ITER_REACHED` to standalone or grouped steady points only when the logged counter or loads-footer fallback equals the requested limit and final logged residual exceeds the convergence limit.
rationale: A loads footer supplies the iteration counter only, never a convergence verdict.

statement: The library shall store the reached counter in `iterations` and requested integer limit in `iterations_requested`, with the latter field only for `MAX_ITER_REACHED`.
rationale: A loads footer supplies the iteration counter only, never a convergence verdict.

statement: The library shall retain 0.38.0 statuses when evidence lacks a counter at the requested limit or readable logged residual, including absent logs and forced iterations without a residual threshold.
The library shall retain `COMPLETED_MAX_ITER` for ended steady runs with footer counters and `FAILED_INCOMPLETE_OUTPUT` for footers lacking the counter line.
The library shall retain `COMPLETED_MAX_ITER` for unsteady loops reaching the prescribed end.
The library shall preserve meaning and precedence of `CONVERGED`, `WALLTIME_REACHED`, `RAN_MISSING_LOG`, `SUBMITTED` and every `FAILED_` status.
The library shall rank person-marked verdicts above `MAX_ITER_REACHED`, as above `COMPLETED_MAX_ITER`.
The library shall admit `MAX_ITER_REACHED` points to every computable post product with one post-log warning naming point and limit.
The library shall exclude `MAX_ITER_REACHED` from resume reruns.
The library shall count `MAX_ITER_REACHED` separately from converged points.
The library shall treat `MAX_ITER_REACHED` as ended and nonfailed for cost estimates, `delete-sims` and grouped collection.
The library shall preserve inside-body user probes with one warning per entry naming count and first points, leaving unaffected row scripts unchanged.
The library shall refuse package-added inside-body probes.
The library shall warn without refusal when containment cannot run because `[geom]` is absent or the mesh is not watertight, stating the reason.
The library shall record geometry inspection through `pyfs-workspace geometry accept NAME[,NAME...]`.
The library shall read `<stem>.build.json` beside each named geometry during matrix planning.

The library shall warn by row and geometry when the built-file digest differs, inspection is absent, audit failed, or `FS_BUILD` differs from the recorded build, naming the accept command or failed gates where applicable.
The library shall preserve previous planning behavior for geometry without `build.json`.
The library shall compute advancing-tip Mach from rotor-tip speed with in-plane and axial free-stream components.
The library shall warn during planning when advancing-tip Mach is at least one.
The library's verification import guard shall cover module-level, deferred and annotation-only imports throughout `tests/tier1_offline`.
The library's shared test support shall remain importable without a licensed-tier dependency.
The library's parity-test support shall exclude fixture imports from other test modules in tier 1.
The library's requirement prose shall exclude quotations of four or more words and first-person pronouns outside code spans.
The library's forbidden-identifier guard shall cover person and employer names in the public SRS.
pyflightstream shall exclude drive-letter and user-profile paths from the public SRS.
rationale: Moved from L2 to L3 at the 0.43.0 instantiation review (R-INST-03): restates the machine-local path exclusion of NFR-43 for the public SRS; a publication guard does not belong under the probe-control feature FR-3157. Former L2 rationale: 0.43.0 trim wording; former statement: The library's public SRS shall exclude drive-letter and user-profile paths.

statement: The library's guard runner shall exit 2 for a missing listed file, naming the file.
The library's guard runner shall exit 1 for failing or unexecuted guards, naming the affected file.
The library shall record staged-input hashes in the manifest.
The library shall collect outputs into declared locations.
The library shall refuse archive and cleanup operations on folders with missing or inconsistent manifests.
The library shall unlink archived staged-geometry links without traversing or deleting link targets.
The library shall report an unresolved artifact id with artifact context and a didactic diagnostic.
The library shall support output-only naming templates with the manifest as sole identity authority and no parse-back API.
The library shall refuse output-name collisions before starting affected campaign points.

The library shall refuse empty, absolute or simulation-escaping output names when rendered, before collection, checking both declaration and rendered name while allowing subdirectories that stay inside the simulation folder.

The library shall refuse duplicate output basenames within a collection and collisions with prior-run destination files, without overwrite permission, naming per-point output naming and simulation archival as remedies.
The library shall refuse duplicate declared-input basenames before staging, naming both sources, except identical declared paths staged once; distinct spellings of the same file remain collisions.
The library shall print sync folder counts and folders without records.
The library shall rebuild no records during sync by default.
rationale: Design constraint: sync invokes pyflightstream.run.records.rebuild only after releasing the manifest lease because rebuild appends to runs.json.

statement: The library shall rebuild unrecorded folders during applying sync with `--restore` or `restore=True`, after releasing the `runs.json` lease.
rationale: Design constraint: sync invokes pyflightstream.run.records.rebuild only after releasing the manifest lease because rebuild appends to runs.json.

statement: The library shall name folders eligible for restoration in sync preview.
rationale: Design constraint: sync invokes pyflightstream.run.records.rebuild only after releasing the manifest lease because rebuild appends to runs.json.

statement: The library shall record refused rebuilds in the sync entry without undoing copied files.
rationale: Design constraint: sync invokes pyflightstream.run.records.rebuild only after releasing the manifest lease because rebuild appends to runs.json.

statement: The library shall refuse `--restore` with `--runs` naming another manifest.
rationale: Design constraint: sync invokes pyflightstream.run.records.rebuild only after releasing the manifest lease because rebuild appends to runs.json.

statement: The library shall publish synced files and matrices by same-folder temporary files verified against source digests before target replacement.
The library shall archive overwritten files by copying while retaining the target until replacement is complete.
The library shall remove interrupted sync temporary files while preserving prior targets.
The library shall refuse differing same-stem matrices by both paths in sync and planning.
The library shall warn by both matrix paths during post and fall back to recorded runs without blocking when same-stem home files differ.
The library shall hold `runs.json.lock` throughout sync preview or apply from record merge through file copying, input linking and matrix copying.
The library shall refuse or lease-wait concurrent restore, run, collect and sync writers while the sync lease is held.
The library shall refuse a sync starting under a held lease by name.
The library shall run requested sync restoration after releasing the lease.
The library shall report `sync hash` file counts, `sync merge` records, and `sync copy` file and byte counts through stage progress.
The library shall record space-in-use reporting calls.

The library shall retain the final `<name>_iteration=<step>` export per point and export name for unsteady every-step exports under default `[[prune_step_exports]]`, deleting earlier steps with preview as the default mode.
The library shall record deleted steps per point.
The library shall remove product-index entries for deleted files.
The library shall retain prior derived product files and entries marked `kept_after_pruning`.
The library shall preview synchronization from `inputs/sync-workspaces.toml` workspaces into main at cumulative levels `runs`, `post`, `fsm`, or `all`.
The library shall resolve sync conflicts in main's favor unless `--prefer-other` is supplied.
The library shall archive main's conflicting file before replacement with the other workspace's file under `--overwrite`.
The library shall preserve the existing refusal text for deleting simulations with `SUBMITTED` records without `--force`.

The library shall apply normal deletion to forced `SUBMITTED` simulations: prior `runs.json` archival, per-simulation note rows, matrix-product handling and staged-link removal preserving mesh targets.
The library shall delete simulations in any non-`SUBMITTED` status with or without force, preserving previous behavior.
The library shall resolve every matrix name or stem consistently across workspace root and `inputs/matrices/` for every matrix-consuming command.
rationale: Design constraint: one workspace-layer resolver serves every matrix-consuming command. Design constraint from FR-524: Matrix discovery shall use the shared resolver rather than maintaining separate lookup rules in individual commands. Additional code anchors inherited from merged or demoted rows: pyflightstream.workspace._matrix_homes:resolve_matrix_arguments; pyflightstream.workspace._matrix_homes:every_matrix. Additional test anchors inherited from merged or demoted rows: tests/tier1_offline/test_matrix_run.py::TestFr310MatrixHomesAll::test_fr310_every_matrix_argument_of_the_parsers_joins_the_one_lookup; tests/tier1_offline/test_matrix_run.py::TestFr310MatrixHomesAll::test_fr310_no_other_routine_lists_the_matrices_of_a_workspace.

statement: The library shall search bare matrix names or stems in both homes of `--workspace`, or the working directory's homes for `upgrade` and `convert`, falling back to the given name only when absent from both.
The library shall read a matrix path containing a folder directly.
The library shall prefer a matrix found in workspace homes over a same-named working-directory file, warning when bytes differ without refusing.
The library shall read identical same-name matrices in both homes once, proceeding as with one file.
The library shall refuse Excel synchronization writes to a matrix name present in both homes even with identical bytes.
rationale: The inherited test checks read-side duplicate resolution; inspect write-side refusal for identical matrices in both homes.

statement: The library shall find running-batch simulations under `sims/batch/*/sim_*/` in status, query verbs, `delete-sims` and `mark-failed`.
rationale: Collected-batch consumers: post, mark-failed, RESTART, rename, rebuild, delete-sims, sync, post --from-sims, free-space and run --force-rerun. A site sync flag is one HPC-profile submit-list entry, without a new mechanism.

statement: The library shall retain running-batch simulations in `sims/batch/<matrix>_b<ID>/sim_<id>/` with per-point `datapoints/DP-<pt>/`, relocating to `sims/sim_<id>/` only through collect.
The library shall refuse differing same-stem matrices in both workspace homes with both paths and remedy, reading identical home files once.
The library shall accept `[[prune_step_exports]]` with either positive integer `keep_last = K` (default 1) or two positive integers `delete_steps = [A, B]` with `A <= B`, refusing both together.
rationale: A step is the solver timestep in <name>_iteration=<step>; a per-step export is the set of files sharing one name. Default keep_last = 1 preserves 0.30.0 behavior.

statement: The library shall delete exactly the inclusive A-to-B range for `delete_steps`, preserving every other step.
The library shall accept empty deletion selections without error, including K at least the disk count and ranges containing no disk steps.
The library shall record which steps were deleted.
The library shall preserve 0.30.0 pruning protections, `SUBMITTED` refusal, preview without `--apply`, call records and removal of deleted product listings.
The library shall record the selected `keep_last` or `delete_steps` value in each prune step entry.
The library shall preserve byte-identical 0.36.0 deletion and recording for recipes specifying neither retention key.
The library shall resolve matrix-command options in descending precedence: command line, workspace-root `pyfs.local.toml`, workspace-root `pyfs.toml`, package defaults.
rationale: Without either configuration file the FR-1001 compatibility guarantee applies.

statement: The library shall locate workspace settings in `--workspace` or the current directory when absent, with either shared `pyfs.toml` or machine-local `pyfs.local.toml` permitted independently.
rationale: Shared pyfs.toml is intended for version control; machine-local pyfs.local.toml is excluded like inputs/executables.local.toml.

statement: The library shall overlay local settings on shared settings key by key.
rationale: Shared pyfs.toml is intended for version control; machine-local pyfs.local.toml is excluded like inputs/executables.local.toml.

statement: The library shall exclude `workspace` as a settings-file key.
rationale: Shared pyfs.toml is intended for version control; machine-local pyfs.local.toml is excluded like inputs/executables.local.toml.

statement: The library shall accept only optional `schema_version = 1`, `[defaults]` and `[log]` in workspace settings files.
The library shall map defaults to long option names without leading dashes and with internal dashes replaced by underscores, applying each option only to commands accepting that option.
The library shall accept `console` and `pproc_warnings` under `[log]`.
The library shall accept shared defaults `fs_version`, `hpc`, `cost_file`, `point_name`, `recipe`, `workflow`, `ignore_missing_families`, `check_frozen`, and `progress_every`.
The library shall accept `fs_exe` and `local` only in `pyfs.local.toml`.
The library shall refuse `runs` in either settings file.
The library shall refuse console keys under defaults with a remedy directing the caller to `[log]`.

The library shall preserve the specified configuration-free 0.39.0 byte parity when neither settings file exists and executable-local settings omit `accept_unregistered_build`, excluding only already-recorded times.
rationale: Compared outputs: console, plan.json, run records and logs/activity.log for the same command line against the same 0.39.0 tree without settings support. Other 0.39.0 changes remain; v0.38.0 comparisons use unaffected fixtures.

statement: The library's tracked reports shall identify files relative to the run workspace or local probe folder.
The library's tier-1 guard shall refuse text writes bypassing the shared text writer, with a planted bypass as control.
rationale: Design constraint: the private text writer centralizes platform-independent LF output; a source-walking guard detects bypasses.

statement: The library shall emit no CR bytes in Windows campaign products or scripts.
The library's products snapshot shall compare line endings identically on Linux and Windows.
The library's emitted solver programs shall use explicit LF endings for every text file written.
The library shall publish complete CSV and text products by atomically replacing the target from a temporary file in the destination directory.
rationale: PFS-2126.024: New guarantee records approved 0.42.0 scope. Supplementary Code: pyflightstream._textio:atomic_text. Supplementary Test: tests/tier1_offline/test_regression_post_tables.py::test_p0420_line_iterator_failure_preserves_published_text.

statement: The library's delete-sims command shall retain the positional selector as a deprecated alias until version 0.43.0.
rationale: PFS-2124.004: New guarantee records approved 0.42.0 scope. Supplementary Code: pyflightstream.run._cli_parsers:_whole_sims. Supplementary Test: tests/tier1_offline/test_matrix_cli.py::test_p0420_p1_1d_delete_positional_alias_warns_and_preserves_selection.

statement: The library shall document each exception's raising condition.
rationale: Design constraint: the exception catalog is the shared export home; the suite rejects exceptions or warnings defined outside that catalog. The inherited exception-hierarchy test does not check documented raising conditions; inspect the exception documentation.

statement: The library shall re-export every exception and warning through one catalog module.
rationale: Design constraint: the exception catalog is the shared export home; the suite rejects exceptions or warnings defined outside that catalog.

statement: The library shall retain plan's 0.31.0 stdout header, adding an opening block only before lines that would precede that header, including refusals.

The library shall print held warnings after the last line of non-plan commands on stderr, including refusal exit 2 and interruption, in raised order under `Warnings (<count>)` preceded by a blank line.
The library shall use the 0.31.0 short `[warning]` form without swallowing warnings or altering filters and Python warning capture.
The library shall retain plan's warning block immediately after the 0.31.0 header block.
The library shall redraw terminal stage progress in place with a 20-cell bar at most every 0.2 seconds, clearing progress before other lines.
The library shall print nonterminal progress at first advance, at most every `PLAIN_PERIOD_S` (10 seconds), and at closing, without carriage returns.
The library shall write plain progress lines to the live log regardless of console type.
The library shall print `[<stage>] failed` for failed or `FAILED`-prefixed outcomes of `verbose_only` stages without `--verbose`, preserving explicitly requested quiet mode.
The library shall suppress nonverbose `verbose_only` started lines and successful-stage lines from the console while recording every line in the activity log.
The library shall separate a warning-free plan's header and first `Cases` block by exactly one blank line.
The library shall export `DEFAULT_DRIFT_LIMIT_PCT` from `pyflightstream.cases` as the default of `PerRevolutionSpec.drift_limit_pct`.
The library shall generate `inputs/INPUTS.md` documenting user-written input files from code-owned formats.

The library shall refresh only the block between `pyflightstream:input-glossary:begin` and `pyflightstream:input-glossary:end`, appending the block when markers are absent and preserving outside content.
The library shall retain legacy `inputs/pproc/INPUTS.md` without updates.
The library shall write `inputs/setups/SETUP_GUIDELINES.md` for `pyfs-matrix plan --setup-guidelines`.
The library shall write complete `s9XX` setup presets for `--setup-standards` independently of `--setup-guidelines`.
The library's guide sources shall carry authorship and CC BY 4.0 license notices.
The library shall end console commands with an 81-column ASCII stderr box containing a phrase and surrounding blank lines, without changing stdout or exit status.
The library shall use a koala for successful post and outcome-specific drawing sets for other success, failure and cancellation.
The library shall retain one short signature line for help and version.
The library shall select one of two run-banner aircraft randomly.

The library shall display the signature for success, failed returns, nonzero exits, uncaught exceptions, interrupts, help, version and post, with compact help/version lines containing `geoversegoddess sees you`.
The library shall retain the signature regardless of flags, environment variables or terminal status.
The library shall encode stderr signatures using the stream encoding with replacement marks for unsupported characters.
The library shall fall back to `geoversegoddess sees you` when a drawing cannot be built, remaining silent only for closed or broken streams.
The library shall preserve command results, exceptions and exit codes when printing signatures.
The cheatsheet coverage guard shall detect a missing or invented command or option against the live parsers.
The library shall document the command and options in the CLI reference and cheatsheet.
The library shall document the mesh face-count column, source, `NA` conditions and absence of post-time counting on the definitions page.
The library shall document all three inventory keys in the input glossary and saved-simulation inventory template example.
The library shall show the common status word when every polar datapoint shares a status.
The library shall show numeric concluded, failed and submitted-or-running datapoint counts for mixed-status polars.
The library shall order status rows by matrix and then numeric simulation id.
The library shall filter status rows through `--sims`, `--matrix`, `--status` and `--failed`.
The library shall accept comma-separated simulation ids with optional square brackets for `--sims`, treating `2006,2007` and `[2006,2007]` identically.
The library shall resolve `--matrix` stems through either matrix home under the shared lookup rules.
The library shall accept repeated recorded status words for `--status`.
The library shall select polars with at least one failed datapoint for `--failed`.
The library shall name simulation ids without records or planned points on stderr.
rationale: The exit status for an unknown simulation id is not specified.

statement: The library shall show unrecorded planned points by default under `planned` status.
The library shall state freshness of files read by status.
The library shall count a planned point under the polar's `planned` datapoints only when no own record, continuation, or row job naming the point or running no points represents that point.
The library shall spell the derived state `planned` in lowercase, distinct from recorded statuses.
The library shall show all-planned polars with status `planned`.
The library shall show recorded and planned datapoint counts for polars containing both.
The library shall write no records, logs, activity entries, live logs, storage entries, archives or boundary inventories during queries.
The library shall neither create nor wait on manifest locks or guards during queries, leaving concurrent campaign writers unimpeded.
The library shall read compacted simulations without expansion, translation or collection.
The library shall identify unreadable queried manifest rows by run id and position while showing readable rows.
The library shall query without scheduler requests or network use by default.
The library shall print only table rows to stdout under `--json` and `--csv`.
The library shall keep console opening blocks and signatures on stderr.
The library shall print one JSON query document containing schema identifier, workspace, read time, each source record file's modification time and rows.
The library shall print only query rows as CSV with LF endings.
The library shall expose each query in `pyflightstream.workspace.ledger` as a function returning plain dictionaries equal to the JSON console rows without requiring pandas.

statement: The library shall support ledger import and query calls without optional dependencies, loading pandas only for an offered dataframe conversion when called.
rationale: Design constraint from FR-776: The module imports only from layers below it (workspace, naming, storage, results tables). Design constraint: delaying dataframe conversion imports preserves dependency-free ledger queries.

statement: The library shall list additional-run register entries through `pyfs-matrix status --additional`.
The library shall query the additional-run register without changing the register.
The library shall derive each datapoint alias as `<sim>_<index>` from the one-based position in planned polar sweep order, without storing aliases.
The library shall accept datapoint aliases wherever run ids are entered, including `delete-sims`, query verbs, `--points` and `mark-failed`.
The library shall print a datapoint alias beside each run id printed by a query.
The library shall assign steady-job points aliases under the same rule as other points.
The library shall name aliases without matching points on stderr.
The library shall assign each module one maturity level from `stable`, `provisional`, `experimental` and `internal`.
The library shall refuse duplicate maturity-table module rows even when levels agree.
The library shall describe every grouped-mode exclusion in `--batch` and `--polar-sweep` help with one phrase per reason-table key.

statement: The library shall direct excluded coupled steady or quasi-steady rows to point-by-point execution without `--batch` or `--polar-sweep`.
rationale: Exclusions: LEGACY; RESTART; warm steady COLD_START false; coupled steady/quasi-steady; unsteady builds lacking the action command; points not spliceable into one job, including double initialization; and fully recorded rows.

statement: The library shall print grouped-plan exclusion reasons without report ids.

statement: The library shall export `derive_thin_blade`, `ThinBlade` and `thin_blade_path` from `pyflightstream.workspace` with the 0.37.0 signatures.
The library shall route `pyfs-matrix degenerate` through `pyflightstream.workspace.derive_thin_blade`.
The library shall expose `--no-<option>` for every file-settable boolean and typed build-acceptance flag on accepting commands, overriding configured true values to false.

statement: The library shall prefer explicit command-line value options over file values for that invocation.

statement: The library shall refuse simultaneous positive and negative boolean options, using exit 2 with both names for the existing ignore-missing-families pair.
rationale: Negated options include no-accept-unregistered-build, no-check-frozen, no-local, no-pproc-warnings and the existing no-ignore-missing-families; parser mutual exclusion handles positive/negative pairs.

statement: The library shall accept `--log-level quiet|normal|verbose` wherever `--verbose` is accepted, treating `--verbose` as verbose level and refusing combination with another explicit level.

statement: The library shall keep every public package name importable with xarray imports blocked.
The library shall refuse retired `farfield.rothalpy` and `farfield.irreversible_deficit` calls without deprecation, identifying removal in 0.40.0 and the ITACA evaluation home.
The library shall exclude `rothalpy` and `irreversible_deficit` from `pyflightstream.farfield.__all__` without requiring reachability-exception rows.

statement: The library shall offer workspace-driven `pyfs-matrix` and Python API routes on the home page.
The library shall generate the exception catalog from exception classes.
The library shall remove unusable names from `__all__` instead of hiding names only on reference pages.

statement: The library shall provide tested Examples sections for every documented-tier entry point in the NFR-29 reference.
The library shall define unsteady reductions only in `docs/post-processing-definitions.md`, with every other mentioning page linking there without repeating definitions.
The library shall place each topic definition first under the home heading whose slug matches the table anchor, with no duplicate defining paragraph on other pages.

The library's guide builder shall generate every guide in `build/guides/` through `scripts/build_guides.py` without writing tracked sources.

rationale: Inspect guide 04 against the public options registry; the inherited receipt test does not check command coverage.

statement: The library shall retain guide sources and licenses in the repository.
rationale: The inherited PDF receipt test does not check retention of every guide source and license; inspect tracked guide sources.

rationale: OPS-2005.08.04: Closed toggle words must be checked by both the public type annotation and runtime; FR-40 concerns CLI registration, not this API. rationale: PFS-2109.016: A packaged resource path can expire or be unwritable; the public manual writer needs a destination contract. Verification plan: test: Invoke from a read-only installed wheel with and without an explicit destination and inspect created files. PFS-2109.016: Merged implementation anchors verified at the SRS application base.

statement: The library shall document every public function in numpydoc form with units and reference frames.
The library shall state each module's pipeline role in the module's top docstring.
The library shall publish at least one worked example per public workflow.
The library shall require `numpy`, `pydantic`, `pandas`, `pyyaml` and `trimesh` in the core runtime dependency set.
rationale: The named core dependency set is the current explicit design constraint; the approved pandas change belongs to the implementing code lane.

statement: The library shall declare heavier dependencies of optional capabilities through named extras.
The library shall report identified workspace artifacts that are missing or whose hashes changed.
The library shall identify published runs by run ID.
rationale: Publication citation practice requires inspection; the inherited reconstruction test checks records, not publications.

statement: The library shall use only synthetic geometry in tests and examples.
The library shall limit committed reports from local research cases to aggregated coefficients.
rationale: The inherited geometry allowlist test does not establish aggregation of research report values; inspect report content.

statement: The library shall resolve every requirement marker to an allocated UID.
The library shall hash file raw bytes for staged inputs, collected outputs, written scripts and solver executables.
The library shall hash UTF-8 text bytes for rendered script text and recipe source.
The library shall exclude wall-clock timestamps, elapsed times, absolute paths, machine names and staging order from digest inputs.
The library shall record the manifest schema version in runs.json.
The library shall apply NFR-20 to added, renamed or removed manifest keys so published run citations remain readable across package versions.
The library shall announce removal of a supported version in a release before removing support.
rationale: The inherited shim test checks a module warning, not prior-release notice of a supported solver or Python version removal; inspect release history.

statement: The library shall announce schema changes within the declared stability scope in the changelog API surface delta.

statement: The library shall apply NFR-20 to column renames and removals within the declared stability scope from version 1.0.
rationale: The source register at 6bad1dac refers to a stability scope below but contains no such scope. This unresolved historical scope is not extended to all tables; the inherited test verifies column documentation only.

statement: The library shall retain each deprecation promise in the deprecation ledger until removal.
The library shall fail the Tier 1 suite when a module imports from a higher layer, enforcing AD-01.
pyflightstream shall refuse, in the offline quality gate, a missing required guard before running the selected tests.
rationale: Moved from L2 to L3 at the 0.43.0 instantiation review (R-INST-04): the offline quality-gate refusal of a missing guard is a guard-runner detail of NFR-44, not a probe-control behaviour of FR-3157.

statement: The library shall raise a typed error containing the exact pip install pyflightstream[<extra>] remedy for a missing optional dependency, without exposing a bare ImportError.
The library shall keep the static type-checking exemption list within the recorded ceiling.
The library shall generate reference documentation from code covering every public name and command-line option.
The library shall execute every exported function's docstring examples.
pyflightstream shall document every exported function with numpydoc Parameters, Returns and applicable Raises sections, stating units for physical parameters.
rationale: Moved from L2 to L3 at the 0.43.0 instantiation review (R-INST-07): restates NFR-30 (numpydoc inputs, outputs and failures of every exported function) and adds the section names, which are detail.

statement: The library shall identify solvers in tracked files by version and build without executable SHA-256 digests.

The library shall write compatibility, physics and drift report digest fields as `withheld; build <build>` for recorded digests or `not recorded` when no digest was taken, without machine paths.
The library shall use the same withheld digest forms in committed C01 receipt copies.
The library shall read executable baselines from local uncommitted copies when comparing executable bytes.
The library shall import shared test helpers from the support module in every consumer.
The library shall prevent tests/tier1_offline modules from importing tests.tier3_licensed or any other licensed-tier module.
pyflightstream shall refuse, in the verification guard, a second definition of the shared test helpers outside the support module.
rationale: Moved from L2 to L3 at the 0.43.0 instantiation review (R-INST-02): restates NFR-39 with the same test; a verification-guard row does not belong under the probe-control feature FR-3157. rationale: The inherited PDF receipt test does not scan tracked build artifacts; inspect tracked source paths.

statement: The library shall report console interruption as unsuccessful.
